label: Brisnik OP-PAIN3
title: SSRI or mirtazapine for neuropathic pain
statement: Prescribed SSRI or mirtazapine for neuropathic pain - and the patient has no other indications for an antidepressant

source.document: Brisnik V, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: indicators of high-risk and overprescribing. BMC Med 2024;22:193, Tables 3-4
source.citation: Brisnik V, Vukas J, Jung-Sievers C, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: development of indicators of high-risk and overprescribing using the RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method. BMC Med 2024;22:193. doi:10.1186/s12916-024-03397-w
source.credit: Brisnik V, Vukas J, Jung-Sievers C, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: development of indicators of high-risk and overprescribing using the RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method. BMC Med 2024;22:193. doi:10.1186/s12916-024-03397-w

plain_summary: An SSRI antidepressant or mirtazapine used only for nerve pain, when the person has no other reason to take an antidepressant, may not be helping.

medicine_groups.name: SSRIs and mirtazapine
medicine_groups.note: Tablets, including those that dissolve in the mouth, oral wafers, capsules and liquids count. A pack labelled with a listed ingredient and a company name counts. SSRI means selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor. Venlafaxine, duloxetine and the older tricyclic antidepressants are not in this group.

needs_facts.what: Neuropathic pain as a reason for the SSRI or mirtazapine being reviewed
needs_facts.meets: The directions, a clinical entry or the pharmacist identify nerve pain as a reason for this SSRI or mirtazapine course. A diagnosis or a generic Yes to having nerve pain is only a clue.

options.words: The SSRI was prescribed for neuropathic pain
Mirtazapine was prescribed for neuropathic pain
Both the SSRI and mirtazapine were prescribed for neuropathic pain
None of these supplies was prescribed for neuropathic pain

needs_facts.what: Any other current indication for an antidepressant
needs_facts.meets: A review confirms no other current indication for an antidepressant during the course under review. Another current indication excludes the finding. If this has not been assessed, the answer is unknown.

options.words: No other current indication besides neuropathic pain was found on review
Another current indication besides neuropathic pain was confirmed

rule_for_models: Require a Group A SSRI or mirtazapine supply. Confirm when an entry links this medicine to nerve pain and a review confirms there is no other current antidepressant indication. Another current indication or use solely for another purpose excludes a finding. With a nerve pain clue and an unresolved treatment purpose or indication review, report a possible finding and ask only about what is missing. A diagnosis or a Yes to having nerve pain is a clue, even if entered for another medicine. Supplies alone give no finding. Cite the supply and supporting clinical entries or pharmacist answers.
cannot_be_seen: Why the antidepressant was started, whether it helps the pain, and any reason for an antidepressant that the record does not hold. Also medicines supplied by a hospital or another pharmacy.
ask_the_gp: What is the SSRI or mirtazapine being used for? If it is for neuropathic pain, could we review its benefit, adverse effects and any other indication?
